footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Accelerant: after $79.8M attributable to noncontrolling interests. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 51.5% to $913M in 2025. Operating income rose 2.5× to $193M, a 21.1% margin.
The company had a net loss of $1.4B, or −$7.49 per share, versus net income of $27.2M. Operating cash flow was $445M and free cash flow $445M, versus $786M.
sources: Accelerant Holdings Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
